headline: Sensex and Nifty Gain Over 500 Points Driven by FMCG, Banking Stocks and FII Buying

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong buying in FMCG, consumer, and banking stocks lifted benchmark indices.
FII buying supported the market rally, bringing Nifty near the 25,300 mark.
GIFT Nifty signaled a potential gap-up opening for the upcoming session.
Export duty on diesel was raised by Rs 2.5 per litre and ATF by Rs 1.5 per litre.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 500 points while Nifty closed near 25,291.
Tata Motors PV slumped 8.7% after JLR revised down its FY27 margin guidance.
RBI sought a review of the Supreme Court order regarding Yes Bank's AT-1 bonds.
Max Healthcare emerged as one of the top gainers in the trading session.
summary: Indian markets ended higher with Sensex gaining over 500 points led by FMCG and banking sectors. Tata Motors dropped sharply following margin guidance cuts for JLR, while Max Healthcare saw positive momentum. Positive global cues and FII inflows continue to support sentiment.
